mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies today near the Verona Area High School. Also, keep your eyes on the horizon tonight as the International Space Station will be visible starting at 8:23 PM for six minutes, rising in the west-northwest over Cross Plains and traveling toward the Northeast near Home Depot, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The big news today involves a residential burglary on Hunter's Cove Way that occurred last Wednesday. Officers arrested a 19-year-old from Madison after recovering a handgun at the scene. Additionally, the Verona Police Department is currently accepting applications for its free nine-week Citizen Academy program running through November.
We have a busy couple of days ahead! You can join a yoga session today at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, local trivia fans have plenty of options with events at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.
On Wednesday, September 10, Verona officers responded to a burglary in progress at a home on Hunter's Cove Way, where a suspect was taken into custody and a firearm was secured.
Although the Culver's of Verona location is open today until 10:00 PM, the store is currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available.
